C0252.title: Woman's Photos Stolen and Maliciously Edited into Pornographic Group, Photo Thief Receives Administrative Penalty
C0252.summary: In January 2022, it was reported that multiple women's photos were stolen and posted to overseas chat groups, with some maliciously edited into nude images for others' gratification. One victim and three others reported the case to the police, and the perpetrator was ultimately given an administrative penalty for defamation and photo theft.
